name: Montserrat
summary_text: Montserrat: archaic criminal provisions on the books (unenforced); tiny, isolated. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of -0.04. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Gay Life in Montserrat - GlobalGayz
sources.claim_summary: GlobalGayz 'Gay Life in Montserrat' (Sept 2012): the island's gay life was decimated by Hurricane Hugo (1989) and the 1995 volcano eruption that made the south a wasteland - 'Gays are everywhere but hardly here'; recovery partial.

AP (Jan 2001): Britain scrapped homosexuality laws in its five Caribbean territories (Anguilla, Cayman Islands, British Virgin Islands, Montserrat, Turks and Caicos) via Privy Council order after local legislatures refused; religious leaders called it 'totally unacceptable'; the territories appeared resigned to following the order.
